name: State Machine Unrolling
description: Replaces explicit algebraic parameter substitution (e.g., $u=0, v=0$) with procedural step-skipping in an unrolled state machine. Models that rely on shallow pattern matching to derive the $O(N)$ closed forms ($\sum p_1$, $\sum p_2$, $p_{1,i} + p_{2,i}$) will fail to map the skipped steps to the corresponding mathematical simplifications, forcing them to either simulate the process or reason deeply about the state invariants.
